name: 2:1 Goodnight Cannabis Honey | 200mg
description: Detroit Edibles took Michigan's own Sleeping Bear Farms honey and infused it with both THC and CBN (cannabinol) to create the perfect blend for relaxation and a restful night's sleep. CBN is a natural cannabinoid that induces drowsiness and pain relief. Simply add it to your favorite cup of tea or spread it on a piece of toast for a great evening snack. Contains 200mg THC / 100mg CBN and fully activates in 1-2 hours.
